fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human name for the theme singleton — the one palette + type system the whole game wears. AAA-minimal: hierarchy and restraint over a flat all-cyan data dump.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Accent
fields.description: The ONE accent colour — used sparingly for emphasis, never as a wash. Cyan, the game's signature neon (floor grid + RimLight). Source nagrand_arena.tscn RimLight.light_color (0, 1, 1).

fields.name: palette
fields.title: Palette
fields.description: Named supporting colours pulled from the live arena — the neon/cyber set the world is actually lit and tinted with. Source nagrand_arena.gd (sky presets, beacon palette, floor accent, mote tints, mountain silhouette).

fields.name: color
fields.title: Color
fields.description: The colour value for this role.

fields.name: fonts
fields.title: Fonts
fields.description: Type system — sans for headings, the same sans for body (the port's HUD/menus stay sans-only; serif body is the doc-system convention, not the in-game UI).

fields.name: heading
fields.title: Heading font
fields.description: Display / heading typeface for menu titles and HUD labels.

fields.name: body
fields.title: Body font
fields.description: Body / data typeface for HUD readouts and menu copy.
